description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query: filter_role_wire is pre-computed as Option<String> by calling s.to_owned() on the filter role. But the String that the role already lives in (inside the filter object on the stack) outlives the filter closure. The type should be Option<&str> with the lifetime tied to filter_role_wire's containing scope, avoiding the heap allocation. As-is every Mailbox/query call with a role filter allocates a redundant String.
title: filter_role_wire returns Option<String> when Option<&str> suffices
